title: Crunchyroll’s Fullmetal Alchemist Successor Confirms Season 2 Return With First Look Trailer – Watch
content: After taking over the year with its debut anime season, the newest anime from Fullmetal Alchemist’ s creator now streaming with Crunchyroll has revealed it’s coming back for its second season.
author: ComicBook

title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: The staff for the television anime of Hiromu Arakawa 's Daemons of the Shadow Realm ( Yomi no Tsugai ) manga announced after the final episode of the first season aired on Sunday that the series will receive a second season.
author: ANN

title: Bleach Officially Returning With Major Event After Anime’s Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has announced that the franchise will be returning with a major event after the anime’s final episode. title: 'Yomi no Tsugai' Second Season in Production
content: The official website of the television anime adaptation of Hiromu Arakawa 's Yomi no Tsugai ( Daemons of the Shadow Realm ) manga announced a second season on Sunday, revealing the announcement visual (pictured) and promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm Season 2 Announced With Teaser Video
content: Daemons of the Shadow Realm Season 2 was officially announced immediately after the first season’s finale finished airing in Japan. Studio BONES FILM is in charge of the animation, with the anime concluding after two consecutive cours and a total of 24 episodes. It’s streaming on Crunchyroll.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Apothecary Diaries Creator to Return With New Anime (First Look Revealed)
content: The Apothecary Diaries has been an absolute runaway hit ever since it made its TV anime adaptation debut a couple of years ago, and now the creator behind the franchise has a new anime on the way that fans will want to keep an eye out for.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Neko to Ryuu' Second Season Announced for 2027
content: The 12th and final episode of Neko to Ryuu ( The Cat and the Dragon ) ended with an announcement on Saturday that a second season is in production. The series director, Jin-koo Oh drew an illustrations to commemorate the announcement (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Cat and the Dragon Anime Gets 2nd Season in 2027
content: The television anime of Amara 's Neko to Ryū ( The Cat and the Dragon ) novels ended its first season on Saturday with an announcement of a second season next year. Update: Crunchyroll announced it will stream the second season.
author: ANN

title: The Cat and the Dragon Season 2 Announced for 2027
content: The Cat and the Dragon ( Neko to Ryu ) is getting a second TV anime season, scheduled to air in 2027. The announcement came following the first season’s finale, which released on September 19, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dengeki Daisy Reveals Main Trailer, Key Visual and 4 New Cast Members Ahead of January 2027 Release
content: Dengeki Daisy anime revealed its first main trailer and key visual, four additional cast members, and a January 2027 release date. The anime will adapt the manga through its conclusion and stream on Crunchyroll. Two consecutive cours have been confirmed, meaning that the anime will run through Spring 2026.
author: Anime Corner
